svg.title: Islamabad Park Road: an actual road-aligned route preview
svg.desc: Real OpenStreetMap streets from the bundled 14 October 2026 Islamabad snapshot. Blue follows the local router's connected public-road detour through Street 21, Street 25 and Street 20. Red is an invented 120-metre-wide Park Road test closure, not a current traffic advisory. All roads, route, closure clips and endpoints use one shared geographic projection.
